_comment: Insider-filing alert config. 100% rule-based (no LLM, zero tokens at runtime). Tune freely; no code change needed.
_comment_forms: Which insider forms to track. 4 = change in ownership (the signal), 4/A = amendment. Add 3/5 only if you also re-seed (see docs).
_comment_tiers: Which signal tiers actually get pushed. HIGH = open-market buys + abnormally large sells. Add MEDIUM to also get ordinary sales.

thresholds._comment: BUYS (code P) are ALWAYS HIGH (insider open-market buys are rare & telling). A SELL is HIGH only if big enough -- and 10b5-1 PRE-PLANNED sells need a much higher bar, because they were scheduled months ago and are not a reaction to current news. Tune these two numbers to taste.

_comment_hours: SEC only accepts filings ~6am-10pm ET on weekdays. Outside this window the poller exits in milliseconds with zero network calls. Set force via --force to bypass.
